definitions.short: Oholibah , a symbolic name for Judah
definitions.full: H172. Oholibah אָהֳלִיבָה proper name, feminine Oholiba (= אָהֳלִֹיבָהּ tent in her = (in meaning) אָהֳלָה compare Sm) of Jerusalem as adulterous wife of ׳י Ezek 23:4 (twice in verse); 23:11 , 22 , 36 , 44 .
definitions.rootNote: (similarly with 170 ) for אׇהֳלִיבָהּ ; from 168 ; my tent (is) in her;
